title: Full low-layer boundary shorting
statement: Prove or sharply refute the full Loewner low-spectral-layer shorting inequality for singular correlation matrices, retaining low-high cross blocks rather than only compressed Rayleigh bounds.

signature.representation: Shorted inverse moment of a singular boundary matrix across a tunable low/high spectral split
signature.state_or_invariant: Low-block floor minus the exact Schur cross budget through the high block
signature.core_candidate_lemma: The full shorted low-layer operator has a universal positive boundary floor on the regime where the complementary high block is stitched separately.
information_retained: multiplicity and width of the low spectral layer
signature.target_implication: This supplies the substantive missing assumption in the audited boundary-ray stitch toward C051.
signature.known_failure_mode: Higher-rank elliptope points have nonzero cross budgets; a kernel compression cannot be promoted to full Loewner order.
signature.verifier_class: exact elliptope boundary examples and symbolic shorted-operator inequalities
